request: Search the web for the latest news about Microsoft layoffs.
result:
**Microsoft layoffs: latest news (as of 4 Nov 2026)**

The main recent story is a voluntary buyout, not a layoff. The last involuntary cuts were in July and September.

**1. Voluntary Exit Offer to about 60,000 employees (26 Oct 2026). Verified.**
- Headlines: "Microsoft Offers Buyouts to 60,000 Employees as It Spends on A.I." (NYT); "Microsoft Is Trying to Shed a Lot of Workers. Just Don't Call It a Layoff" (WSJ)
- Sources: NYT (https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/26/technology/microsoft-buyouts-ai-spending.html); WSJ (https://www.wsj.com/business/microsoft-job-cuts-buyout-offers-ff3c5dde); The Guardian (https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/oct/26/microsoft-buyout-offers-ai-cuts); Business Insider (https://www.businessinsider.com/microsoft-is-offering-buyouts-read-the-memo-2026-10)
- Summary: Offered to employees at level 70 and below in participating teams in the US, Canada, UK and India. About 60,000 are eligible, roughly 27% of the ~223,000 workforce. Decisions are due in early December, and takers leave on 31 Dec 2026. Participating teams reportedly include Copilot, Windows and Devices, Xbox, finance and HR. Sales, security, commercial and data-center teams are reportedly excluded.
- Official statement (Chief People Officer Amy Coleman): "This is a time-limited, voluntary program that gives those who are eligible the opportunity to leave Microsoft with financial support and career planning resources." Microsoft says the buyout is not AI-driven. A spokesperson confirmed the 60,000 figure to Business Insider.

**2. About 4,800 job cuts, with an Xbox overhaul (6 Jul 2026). Verified.**
- Headline: "Microsoft to cut 4,800 jobs, overhaul Xbox unit" (Reuters, https://www.reuters.com/business/world-at-work/microsoft-joins-ai-driven-tech-layoff-wave-with-4800-job-cuts-2026-07-06)
- Summary: About 2.1% of staff, mainly in sales, consulting and Xbox. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma's memo planned to eliminate about 3,200 Xbox roles across FY2027 and divest four studios.
- Official statement: Coleman wrote that the eliminated roles were "not being replaced by AI."

**3. Further Xbox cuts (Sep 2026). Verified.**
- Source: Business Insider (https://www.businessinsider.com/microsoft-starts-a-new-round-of-job-cuts-2026-9)
- Summary: About 500 cuts, including 268 named roles at Halo Studios, other first-party studios and XGS. Xbox's Matt Booty said the restructuring is "roughly three-quarters of the way" complete. A Washington WARN filing reportedly showed 605 Xbox job losses.

**Earlier context: voluntary retirement program (Apr–Jul 2026).** About 8,750–9,000 eligible US employees (senior director and below, age plus service of at least 70). Roughly one-third took it. Source: https://www.kore1.com/microsoft-layoffs-2026

**Reported claims (not confirmed by Microsoft)**
- Fortune reports further Xbox cuts in November 2026 and January 2027, citing anonymous sources (https://www.firstpost.com/tech/xbox-layoffs-microsoft-plans-fresh-job-cuts-in-november-and-january-report-says-14054175.html).
- Quartz reports headcount will keep falling "over the next several quarters" (https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/microsoft-voluntary-retirement-buyout-package-131245489.html).

**Speculation / rumour**
- A rumoured 11,000–22,000 cuts in January. Microsoft's Chief Communications Officer Frank X. Shaw called it "100 percent wrong." The denial was relayed through social posts and secondary coverage, so treat its sourcing as weak.

**Still open:** the take-up rate of the buyout (known after the December deadline) and whether the November/January Xbox cuts happen.

I'd treat the 60,000 figure and the July and September cuts as solid. The Fortune claim and the January rumour are not confirmed.
